name: Peerless Propaganda
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 4, mesmerist 4; Focus conveyance 4, tool 4

CASTING

Casting Time 10 minutes
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one work of art
Duration until discharged (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (object, see text); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You imbue your magic into a work of art, making it a vector for your will. As part of casting the spell, you must also cast a mind-affecting spell of 3rd level or lower that targets one or more creatures at the artwork, even though it is not a creature. You lose access to your knowledge of that spell, and the slot used to cast it, until peerless propaganda ends. The artwork gains the aura of that spell and will cast it on valid targets other than you that observe it as if it was cast by you. R single artwork may only store one spell at a time. For the duration, the art’s appearance shifts to reflect the nature of the spell inside of it. When cast by the artwork, the spell has no manifestation. The spell does not grant the artwork senses or agency. The spell will be cast on the closest valid targets among observers within the spell’s range as soon as there is at least one such target. When the spell placed inside the art requires you to make choices or issue a specific suggestion, you must do so when you cast it, and the art will apply it to every target. The piece’s artistic merit “speaks” to observers in a way all possible targets of the spell it contains can understand, allowing spells with the language-dependent descriptor to be used through it. If the spell requires you to perform any action other than the above, it fails.
